image_prompt: Night photo of the Seattle skyline seen across Elliott Bay with the Space Needle clearly in the foreground on the left; behind the city on the right a gigantic nuclear fireball and mushroom cloud rises into the sky, glowing bright orange and yellow, lighting the clouds, the towers and the water.
